problems: The blind guess (a fish in side profile) does not match. The figure reads as a kite with a string and a trailing ribbon, not a fish with a dome head and tapering tail. The guess was also low-confidence (2/5) and the alternatives were no closer.
The kite body is only sketched as thin blue and gold outlines. There is no clear filled silhouette, so the shape is hard to read as an object.

Star placement is roughly right: the left corner (73714) sits at about (140,305), the right corner (72197) at about (248,309), the foot (72571) at about (224,376), the first fold (70753) at about (352,419), the second fold (70306) at about (384,373), the far tip (69415) at about (447,365), and the string end (74392) at about (84,161). The kite, ribbon and string are all in the right order.

Labels collide: 'the kite's left corner, where' overlaps 'the kite's right corner', and 'the second fold, where the r' overlaps 'the far tip of the ribbon'. The far-tip label is also clipped at the right edge.
The ribbon sits on a long, smooth arc under the kite, which works as a tail, but the arc is shallow and its folds are small, so the snap-up at the second fold is weak.
output.advice: Redraw so the silhouette reads clearly as a sun-kite with a ribbon. Keep the seven star positions. Make the kite a filled diamond or kite shape between stars 73714 (left corner, around (140,305)), 72197 (right corner, around (248,309)) and 72571 (foot, around (224,376)). Run the string from 73714 up-left to 74392 (around (84,161)). Draw the ribbon as a clearly curved tail from 72571 down through 70753 (around (352,419)), up sharply to 70306 (around (384,373)), then curling right and over to 69415 (around (447,365)). Make the second fold a deeper snap so it stands out. Move labels off each other: put the left and right corner labels on opposite sides, and place the far-tip label above or inside the frame so it is not clipped. Keep the figure upright; it already is.
